record_title: Prime plus two positive cubes below 333334^3
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint was submitted on 17 September 2026, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. The large computations underlying the cited source theorem are used as published inputs and were not independently rerun. The new triple-cube exclusion is finite through t=333333 and does not prove the corresponding conjecture in general. No independent validation is asserted.
